status: QUALIFIED: clean warmed interactive performance measurement completed at representative 40- and 60-active-cap battle loads. This is measurement qualification, not release acceptance or a guaranteed 60 FPS claim.
head: 195ea79c9b88096bafc8d18030a2980d945231f1
preservation: No gameplay/source/config changes. All previous dirty/new work preserved; original git status unchanged. No reset, clean, merge, push, new worktree, Hyper Combat integration, external communication or deployment.

build.configuration: Previously qualified r11 packaged Development, UE 5.8.3-58210709

environment.cpu: Intel Core i7-7700HQ, 4 cores / 8 logical processors
environment.display: Visible native windowed game, 1280x720, D3D11; default commander overview
environment.quality: Epic scalability (3); r.ScreenPercentage=0 selects default, r.ScreenPercentage.Default=100; VSync=False; t.MaxFPS=0 / FrameRateLimit=0; dynamic resolution disabled
environment.audio: Enabled in both runs; not a listening qualification
environment.lease: Studio-Control Global\RefinedBadger_Unreal_<machine> held exclusively by run_interactive.ps1; no concurrent Unreal process; released at normal exit
environment.background: Existing desktop applications preserved. Background process delta recorded; this is an interactive workstation measurement, not an isolated laboratory or shipping benchmark.

method.input: Native Computer Use key input; no screenshot requests, offscreen rendering or automated proof flags. Combat resumed before accepted profiler commands. Small UE console closes after Return; later P input successfully pauses gameplay.
method.profiler: Unreal csvprofile frames=2400; actual FrameTime, GameThreadTime, RenderThreadTime, RHIThreadTime and GPUTime. No Tick-derived timing.
method.selection: Predeclared whole frames within seconds 5..35 of CSV capture. No per-frame removal, no outlier trimming. Complete raw CSV retained.
method.warmup_60: 126.9s initial live combat, then 69.58s additional live combat in rejected capture; third encounter loaded 02:34:45.938Z, resumed 02:35:41.812Z, CSV began 02:35:55.535Z. Accepted window begins about 74.6s after reload completion and 18.7s after combat resume.
method.warmup_40: 131.6s initial live combat, then 85.24s additional live combat in rejected capture; third encounter loaded 02:42:35.292Z, resumed 02:43:39.236Z, CSV began 02:43:52.820Z. Accepted window begins about 82.5s after reload completion and 18.6s after combat resume.
method.logging: SoulControlDiagnostics disabled. LogTemp Warning suppresses per-contact/stance/reaction display traffic before capture. Exactly eight ordinary skeletal component creation lines in each accepted 30s window; no verbose/control/contact logs, load/flush warnings or errors.
method.counter_acceptance: Every retained frame has zero package queue depths, streamables in flight, pending IO, level loads/visibility work and texture stream-in data; desired texture data=100%; shader loaded/created counters stable; no CSV events. Created-shader counter can be negative after resource teardown; stability/delta, not its absolute value, is the check.
method.load_semantics: Initial 40=20/20 and 60=30/30 live actors, with finite pools 46/30 and 46/46. Live combat includes movement, attacks, deaths and reinforcement component creation; casualties/replacements occur naturally. This does not claim a constant exact number alive in every measured frame. Exact per-frame alive telemetry was deliberately not enabled.
method.scope: Representative commander-view combat in the current campaign package. No player spell casts during accepted samples; not a spell-heavy stress scene, campaign-only traversal benchmark, first-launch benchmark, physical-controller acceptance or long soak.

post_capture_endpoint.note: Endpoint is after raw capture; not a per-frame alive count in the selected window.
Endpoint is after raw capture; not a per-frame alive count in the selected window.

rejected_evidence.reason: Initial warm-up only. Escape exited normally after console had already auto-closed; no CSV measurement.
Resume arrived 5.7s after CSV start, overlapping predeclared sample by about 0.7s; also 4 shader creations and texture stream-in. Not qualified.
4 shader creations and texture stream-in despite initial warm-up. Counter checks reject it. Not qualified.

performance_assessment.interpretation: GPUTime is close to FrameTime while game-thread time is lower in both samples, consistent with GPU-dominant steady-state throughput. Thread/GPU counters overlap and must not be summed.
performance_assessment.outlier: One 44.6049ms frame at 40 active retained. Nearby pipelined RHI/render-thread and cloth-wait activity is recorded in retained-spike.json; timing counters alone do not establish cause. No >50ms or >100ms frames in either accepted window.
performance_assessment.regression: No concrete, safely attributable SoulRealtimeBattle regression established. Historical captured/diagnostic timings remain confounded and are not a clean baseline; do not claim improvement/regression against them.
performance_assessment.fixes: None indicated within admitted authority. No source changes or new subsystem.
performance_assessment.regression_gates: No implementation change to gate. Prior r11 automation/native/source/cooked gameplay qualification retained; source and executable hashes reverified.

visual_sanity: No new visual pass needed: no presentation or gameplay change. Prior qualified battle result, dragon/griffin facing, hammer fit and reinforcement receipts remain authoritative. No screenshots captured in this continuation.
remaining_human_only_gates: Physical controller feel and actual device input during play.
Subjective movement/contact polish and donor open-palm grip/portrait art choices.
next_meaningful_action: Hands-on review of the existing r11 package for the remaining human-only gates. Clean interactive performance measurement is no longer pending. No canonical mission-complete or release declaration.
final_state: Both measurement game processes exited 0; exclusive Unreal lease released; no Unreal/Soul process left running.
